name: LoopInterchange
description: Reorders loop dimensions in structured operations to improve memory access patterns and cache locality. Applies permutations to iterator orders via transform.structured.interchange.

parameters.name: iterator_permutation
parameters.description: List of non-negative integers specifying the new iterator order. Example: [1, 0, 2] swaps the first two loops and keeps the third. Must be a valid permutation of [0, 1, ..., N-1].
